notice.waiversNotAuthorized: Editing the waiver is limited to owners and managers.
notice.exportNotAuthorized: Data export is limited to owners and managers.
notice.reportsNotAuthorized: Reports read the shop’s revenue, so they’re limited to owners and managers.
notice.settingsNotAuthorized: Shop settings are managed by the owner or a manager. Your calendar subscription is still yours to set up.
notice.teamNotAuthorized: Team management is limited to owners and managers.
notice.importNotAuthorized: Importing writes divers’ personal and medical records, so it’s limited to owners and managers.
notice.gearImportNotAuthorized: Importing gear service history is limited to owners and managers.
notice.diveSiteImportNotAuthorized: Importing dive sites is limited to owners and managers.
notice.promosNotAuthorized: Promo codes are limited to owners and managers.
notice.billingNotAuthorized: Billing is limited to the owner.
notice.dayBlowoutNotAuthorized: Calling a whole day off is limited to owners, managers and captains. You can still call one departure from its own page.
notice.activityNotAuthorized: The activity log is limited to owners and managers.

orientation.heading: New here? A few pointers for your role

owner.title: You’re steering the whole shop
owner.desc: Today is your work queue: bookings, blockers, and today’s departures in one place.
owner.tryThis: Open Schedule to see this week’s departures.

manager.title: Keeping the shop running day to day
manager.desc: Today surfaces what needs attention first; the rest of the shop’s admin lives under More in the nav.
manager.tryThis: Check Reviews for feedback waiting on you.

instructor.title: Teaching and certifying divers
instructor.desc: Divers holds every diver’s certification records and specialty history.
instructor.tryThis: Open Divers to check a certification record before class.

assistant_instructor.title: Assisting in the water while divers train
assistant_instructor.desc: Divers holds what each student has on file before you get in the water with them.
assistant_instructor.tryThis: Open Divers to read a student’s record before you get in.

divemaster.title: Getting divers ready to board
divemaster.desc: Today lists every diver who can’t board yet, with the one tap that fixes each one.
divemaster.tryThis: Open Today to see who still needs prep.

captain.title: Running the boat
captain.desc: The manifest is your boarding pass and roll call, built for wet hands and spotty signal.
captain.tryThis: Open today’s manifest to see who’s on the boat.

crew.title: Checking divers in as they arrive
crew.desc: The Divers tab shows who’s arrived, who’s still missing paperwork, and what to do about it.
crew.tryThis: Open the next boat’s Divers tab to check divers in as they arrive.
